title: Oak Stump
summary: Uncommon stump. Place anywhere: regrows a Oak Log every 30s. Chop it for the log, a little Foraging XP and a good chance of a Splinter. Sneak and hit it with an empty hand to pick it up.

lines.x: Place anywhere: regrows a Oak Log every 30s. Chop it for the log, a little Foraging XP and a good chance of a Splinter. Sneak and hit it with an empty hand to pick it up.

s.x: Sold by Fernhollow Timber for 24x Heartwood Splinter (needs Foraging level 3)
